consumer: The frontend inventory panel renderer that reads avatar.carried_items[] from the snapshot and SHOWS the top-level list of held items; it asks 'what items is the player holding to display?', not a yes/no.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded + worn + top-level inventory stacks), NOT recursed into container contents and NOT nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() and emits each item's name/symbol/location/charges as a filtered top-level view for the panel, never recursing into contents and never computing a predicate.
divergence: Player wields a backpack containing a knife: a correct top-level display shows only the backpack (one row); a wrong answer that recursed via visit_internal into contents would also list the knife as carried, exposing the wrong reach/view in the panel.
